title_en: Character Riddles (11/20): When Your Heart Goes Missing
note_en: The pattern 一会儿……一会儿…… describes someone switching back and forth between activities: 张老师一会儿改作业，一会儿接电话 "Ms. Zhang was grading homework one minute and answering the phone the next." It's often followed by 得 plus 连……都……, as in 忙得连喝水都忘了 "so busy she even forgot to drink water," where 连 marks the surprising extreme.
